description: The U.S.S. Stargazer is a sagan-class ship that is a far cry from its "overworked, underpowered, always on the verge of flying apart at the seams" predecessor. The U.S.S. Stargazer is in a class of its own, not least because it has been outfitted with components derived from Borg research. With updated weapons systems and boosted quad nacelles, this new and improved U.S.S. Stargazer is truly a force to be reckoned with.
